title: Berkeley Capital Partners LLC Reduces Position in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Posted by Nicole Wilson on Mar 30th, 2018 // No Comments 
Berkeley Capital Partners LLC lessened its stake in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 10.2% during the third quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the SEC. The fund owned 3,923 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 446 shares during the quarter. Berkeley Capital Partners LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $605,000 as of its most recent SEC filing. 
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors also recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Barnett & Company Inc. boosted its position in Apple by 60.2% during the second quarter. Barnett & Company Inc. now owns 2,394 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $345,000 after acquiring an additional 900 shares during the last quarter. Suffolk Capital Management LLC boosted its position in Apple by 4.3% during the second quarter. Suffolk Capital Management LLC now owns 207,994 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $29,955,000 after acquiring an additional 8,534 shares during the last quarter. Benedict Financial Advisors Inc. boosted its position in Apple by 0.5% during the second quarter. Benedict Financial Advisors Inc. now owns 39,107 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,877,000 after acquiring an additional 201 shares during the last quarter. Bank of Stockton raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 0.3% during the second quarter. Bank of Stockton now owns 20,598 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,966,000 after purchasing an additional 69 shares during the period. Finally, Reik & CO. LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 3.9% during the second quarter. Reik & CO. LLC now owns 4,243 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $611,000 after purchasing an additional 158 shares during the period. 61.35% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. In related news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available at this hyperlink . Company insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. 
Several equities analysts have recently weighed in on the stock. Royal Bank of Canada reiterated a “buy” rating and set a $203.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday. Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday. Nomura set a $175.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a report on Wednesday. Goldman Sachs restated a “neutral” rating and issued a $159.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday. Finally, UBS set a $190.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $202.62. 
Shares of NASDAQ AAPL opened at $167.78 on Friday. Apple has a 1 year low of $140.06 and a 1 year high of $183.50. The stock has a market cap of $854,159.38, a P/E ratio of 17.24, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.28 and a beta of 1.19. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. During the same period last year, the company posted $3.36 EPS. Apple’s revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. research analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
